summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting the grant of 27,030 warrants to employees under its Articles of Association, with an exercise price of $213.23 per share, vesting over a one-year cliff and monthly thereafter. This is a routine equity incentive grant, not a special situation. The filing also notes an amendment to the Articles of Association to authorize the grant and confirms that 1,553,563 warrants remain available for future grant. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activism, restructuring, or similar event. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements.
